narrative.overview: TraceCtrl is a high-stakes precision instrument for security observability and runtime control of AI agents. The interface reflects the responsibility of watching over complex, potentially compromised systems: information-dense but never chaotic, authoritative but never alarming.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first tonal layering: depth through surface steps, not shadows
Red as a leadership accent — commanding voice, not a warning color
Dense information hierarchy through scale and weight contrast, not whitespace
Monospaced type (JetBrains Mono) for all data, IDs, counts, timestamps
Flat at rest; state (hover, active, selected) reveals structure

rules.oneVoice: Signal Red is the primary voice. Every other color defers to it. Protect its reflex by keeping red off neutral content.
rules.riskIsolation: The four risk colors exist solely for severity communication. Use jade for non-risk confirmations.
rules.registerDivide: Poppins for human-readable language; JetBrains Mono for machine-readable data.
rules.weightContrast: Scale steps must carry a weight shift: 800/700 for display/headline, 600 for title, 400 for body.
rules.flatByDefault: No shadows at rest. Depth is a property of the surface stack.
rules.glowException: Faint red glow permitted only on active violation alerts and toast notifications for HIGH/CRITICAL severity.

dos: Use Signal Red to lead visual hierarchy: section tags, active nav, primary buttons, violation headlines
Use JetBrains Mono for all machine-readable data
Express depth through the surface stack, not shadows or blurs
Use 12% translucent backgrounds for risk badges
Reserve risk colors exclusively for agent/guardrail severity signals
Apply the Section Tag pattern as the standard page heading eyebrow
donts: Don't build like Splunk or legacy SIEM dashboards
Don't dramatize risk with aggressive red everywhere
Don't build generic SaaS widget grids with identical cards
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as colored accents (nav active indicator is the sole exception)
Don't use background-clip: text with gradient backgrounds
Don't use the hero-metric template (large centered number + gradient)
Don't apply risk color scale to non-security signals
